items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua officially active vs Raiders despite calf injury.
items.why: Optimistic reports Saturday; no setbacks; officially active
items.implication: Full or near-full WR1 role expected in favorable matchup
items.opportunity: High routes/targets if healthy; reverse any backup beneficiaries

items.text: Christian McCaffrey went to locker room then returned to game (quad/thigh).
items.why: Left briefly then back; ETR monitoring quad
items.implication: Continued heavy usage but monitor post-game status
items.opportunity: Still lead back; limited backup opportunity while active

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall officially inactive; unlikely after limited practice and quad strain.
items.why: Hasn't been full participant; bit early for return after missing games
items.implication: Backfield lead stays with other RBs another week
items.opportunity: Elevated carries/snaps for Jets RBs behind him

items.text: Lamar Jackson ruled OUT for Week 7; Tyler Huntley expected to start again.
items.implication: Huntley starts; Ravens pass game and Henry/Flowers usage elevated in volume but efficiency risk
items.opportunity: Increased snap share for Zay Flowers, Derrick Henry, Mark Andrews/Isaiah Likely

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks both OUT.
items.implication: Eagles WR depth thin; TE and remaining WRs elevated
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for Dallas Goedert and other Eagles pass-catchers

items.text: Watching in-game/ late: Jahmyr Gibbs (ankle on slide), CMC (quad returned), Jaylen Waddle (shoulder), Cam Skattebo/Tyrone Tracy (hamstring), Kenny Gainwell (hip returned).
items.why: Sunday night summary of injuries sustained or monitored
items.implication: Potential Week 8 status changes; Gibbs/Waddle/Skattebo key
items.opportunity: Handcuff/backup elevation if escalate to OUT

items.text: All ETR projections updated to reflect latest injury news including Lamar OUT, Puka GTD/opt, Breece GTD/pess, Saquon expected, Smith/Wicks OUT, Jacobs et al IN.
items.why: Direct response to ETR weekend summary
items.implication: DFS and season-long projections now current on statuses

items.text: Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY after hamstring return to practice.
items.why: Weekend reports optimistic for MNF return
items.implication: Lead back role if active; monitor final status
items.opportunity: High carries/red-zone if cleared; limits backups

items.text: IN: Josh Jacobs, Jonah Coleman, Christian Kirk, Jordan Mason, Tank Dell, Dylan Sampson.
items.implication: Role returns; Kirk boosts 49ers WR depth with Evans/Deebo out
items.opportunity: Snap shares for returners; 49ers WR opportunity redistribution

items.text: Cam Skattebo expected to resume lead back role vs Texans; finished with 124 yards on 17 carries and 1 TD.
items.why: Sources confirm expected lead role; production followed
items.implication: Primary carries and goal-line; later hamstring watch
items.opportunity: High snap/carry share; Tracy also hamstring

items.text: Packers RB Josh Jacobs activated and expected to play Sunday.
items.why: Activated from injured list; returns to field
items.implication: Resumes lead or significant RB role post-layoff
items.opportunity: Carries and red-zone work; monitor snap share vs committee

items.text: Kenneth Walker III on pace for record rushing yards; more yards/TDs than all Seahawks RBs combined in fewer games.
items.implication: Continue as high-end RB1 with heavy carries

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown for usage and matchup (WR10 range).
Loves Tucker Kraft in TE buffet matchup vs Lions (allowed many TE TDs/points).
Loves volume RBs Jaylen Warren, Chuba Hubbard, Bucky Irving for workloads in friendly matchups.
items.why: Big workloads vs defenses carved by RBs; consistency

items.text: Hates Rome Odunze (shadowed) and Josh Downs in tough spots.
items.why: Odunze outside shadow likely; Downs tough matchup/low floor history
